correctness.rationale: For a fixed length and weight three, the 011,110,001 counts reconstruct all eight three-deck entries using fixed one-count, zero-count, and the first two moments of preceding-zero counts. Equal 011,110 constrain one-position changes to (s,-2s,s). Equal 001 imposes the exact polynomial \(s(3s-(x-y))=0\), leaving at most a unique nontrivial involutive twin. Orienting by the larger first gap, the admissible pairs are in bijection with (a,y,s) with y,s>=1 and 0<=a<=n-1-2y-4s; summing choices yields the rational correction. The full proof covers all lengths; packaged verifier independently confirms 66,045 words of lengths 3..36 and series terms 0..140. Finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: The central rational generating function is visibly printed as Conjecture 1, supported there only by 20 coefficients, in Chrisnata et al. (first online 2021-08-30). Their §5.3 already gives a zero-block kernel, basic inequalities and the length-seven collision; these are not presented as new. The new proof proves a complete quadratic-root involution classifying every collision pair and derives the conjectured coefficients for all lengths. The 2026 full-deck asymptotic bound treats all Hamming weights together and does not determine the fixed-weight-three distribution. Searches of relevant published records, mathematical literature and the closest accessible preceding findings did not expose an equivalent exact theorem. As in any search, this does not certify worldwide priority; unindexed equivalent results remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent full solution under other terminology or in inaccessible/unindexed literature cannot be ruled out by a search.
